diagnosis.plain_language: Irreversible pulpitis is inflammation of the soft inner tissue (pulp) of a tooth that does not settle on its own; the number 46 refers to a specific tooth in dental notation.

medications.name: Augmentin
medications.purpose_plain: Augmentin is an antibiotic that combines amoxicillin with clavulanic acid, generally used to treat bacterial infections.

medications.name: Brufen
medications.frequency: three times daily (morning, afternoon and night)
medications.purpose_plain: Brufen is a brand of ibuprofen, a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicine generally used to relieve pain and reduce inflammation and fever.

medications.name: Pan
medications.purpose_plain: Pan is a brand of pantoprazole, a medicine that reduces stomach acid and is generally used for acid-related stomach conditions.

advice_verbatim: Soft diet, avoid cold. RCT adv.
